title: Smart Port System Prototype
description: Creating a smart system in a port area such as early warning of tidal flooding, automatic activation of port area lighting.

title: Face Detection System Using Mask by Utilizing Artificial Intelligence
description: Utilizing Artificial Intelligence as an early detection tool in public facilities during the Covid-19 pandemic. With this project, it is expected to reduce interaction between officers or guards of public facilities with users of public facilities, in addition to being able to control and remind people who have not used masks to immediately use their masks in public places.

title: AI and Robotics Seminar with the title Active and Fun Learning with Robotics in the Classroom
partner: PT.Racer Robotic Indonesia x Indobot Academy
description: This seminar aims to equip teachers from elementary to high school levels with basic understanding and skills regarding the use of robotics as an active, creative and enjoyable learning medium for students.

title: History and Benefits of Robotics: Media Spotlight on Kampong Robot
partner: PT.Racer Robotic Indonesia x Secret Story Trans7
description: Participating in media coverage by Trans7 Secret Story in Kampong Robot, which carries the theme “History of Robotics and Its Benefits”. The segment showcases various educational robotics innovations and the role of Kampong Robot in inspiring young people to engage with technology and automation from an early age.
